say:1:1034402001:0.text: Staring directly at the moon is taboo in Ivoryshade. We judge when Prayer Day is approaching by the shadows cast by moonlight.
say:1:1034402001:0.source_cn: 直视月亮在月影乡是无礼和鲁莽的表现，我们会通过月光下的...
say:1:1034402001:0.male: Staring directly at the moon is taboo in Ivoryshade. We judge when Prayer Day is approaching by the shadows cast by moonlight.
say:1:1034402001:0.female: Staring directly at the moon is taboo in Ivoryshade. We judge when Prayer Day is approaching by the shadows cast by moonlight.

say:2:1034402002:0.text: When the blessed full moon arrives, its shadow changes to a soft, silvery gray.
say:2:1034402002:0.source_cn: 祈福的圆月来临时，影子会变成柔和清淡的银灰色。
say:2:1034402002:0.male: When the blessed full moon arrives, its shadow changes to a soft, silvery gray.
say:2:1034402002:0.female: When the blessed full moon arrives, its shadow changes to a soft, silvery gray.

say:3:1034402003:0.text: That's when we will bask in its light and pray to the Deer Spirit at the altar...
say:3:1034402003:0.source_cn: 我们会沐浴在圆月的光辉下，在祭坛向鹿灵祈福……
say:3:1034402003:0.male: That's when we will bask in its light and pray to the Deer Spirit at the altar...
say:3:1034402003:0.female: That's when we will bask in its light and pray to the Deer Spirit at the altar...
